items.title: The library at the end of the line
items.description: A short branching story: a night train, a station that is not on the map, and a library that should not be there.

adventure.death_text_html: The lamp goes out and the shelves close over the platform. The train leaves without you.
adventure.victory_text_html: You write one line, and the station lets you go. The book is in your bag when you wake.

nodes.text_html: The train stops at a station that is not on the map. The doors open on a platform lit by a single lamp, and beyond it, a library.
The shelves run further than the building should allow. A librarian looks up: 'You are early. The book you need is not written yet.'

choices.text: Ask what the book is about

nodes.text_html: 'It is about a reader who arrives too early and writes the missing pages,' she says, and hands you a pen.
The doors close. The train moves on, and the station is gone. The timetable lists a stop that never was.

outcomes.text_html: The doors close. The train moves on, and the station is gone. The timetable lists a stop that never was.

nodes.text_html: She points to the far door. You walk until the shelves become trees, and the trees become the edge of the town you left that morning.

nodes.text_html: You write one line: 'The train stops at a station that is not on the map.' The lamp goes out, and you are in your seat again.
